blocks.text: The module documentation describes cancellation, failure-breaker, and token-budget behavior, including the shared run_guard key namespace and the local hot-path cache.
blocks.title: Three safety rails

blocks.text: Environment-backed limits, Redis TTLs, and local dictionaries define the safety state. _k namespaces keys and _safe keeps bookkeeping exceptions from escaping.
blocks.title: State and bookkeeping primitives

blocks.text: begin_run clears local and Redis rails for a new task. request_cancel persists a reason, while cancel_reason consults local, cached remote, and Redis state.
blocks.title: Fresh-run reset and cancellation

blocks.text: The module reads the current soft budget, adds provider usage to local and Redis counters, and compares usage with soft and hard limits.
blocks.title: Token accounting

blocks.anchor: def record_role_outcome(session_id: str, ok: bool, role: str = None) -> "str | None":
blocks.text: Successful roles reset the consecutive streak. Failed roles increment streak and total counters, persist a tripped reason after either threshold, and expose that reason to callers.
blocks.title: Failure breaker

blocks.text: grant_more extends the budget from the greater of configured budget and actual usage, clears failure and cancellation state, and returns current budget information.
blocks.title: Manual budget grant

blocks.text: raise_if_stopped converts a cancellation or hard token-limit condition into RunStopped. The soft budget and breaker remain role-boundary concerns.
blocks.title: LLM-path enforcement

purpose: The guard gives long-running agent work cheap stop checks and resumable limits. It mirrors state locally for hot paths, persists shared facts in Redis with expiry, fails open for bookkeeping errors, and raises RunStopped only for explicit cancellation or hard token exhaustion.
summary: Maintains per-session cancellation, token-budget, and repeated-role-failure safety rails across workers.
